source: version and description from Postgres public."SDKVersion"; pushed_date from the package registry publish date, falling back to CHANGELOG.md, git tags, then manifest history

sdk_versions.description: Added Google Integrated Conversion Measurement (ICM) via the on-device measurement SDK, a consent model for Google Ads, and opt-in IAB TCF consent collection.
Exposed ad-network campaign, ad set, and creative identifiers and names in attribution responses.
Made paymentId mandatory for payment capture and rejected missing or whitespace-only values.
Added setCustomerUserId, which persists the application user ID and automatically includes it with subsequent tracked events.
Added handleDeeplink support for deeplink-based re-engagement attribution.
Added Netcore device GUID support to signup and user-data requests.
Added optional event data to payment capture and support for Meta Commerce Event Manager.
Added Google Analytics session ID collection so Linkrunner events can be correlated with analytics sessions.
Added automatic Apple AdServices attribution-token collection for iOS 14.3 and later.
Added event IDs to custom-event requests and improved payment input handling.
Added Google Analytics app instance ID and Braze device ID fields for linking Linkrunner users with analytics profiles.
Added an API to register or update a device push token for uninstall tracking and messaging integrations.
Added exponential-backoff API retries, non-blocking public error handling, and backward-compatible error responses.
Added the SECOND_PAYMENT payment type and updated install-time handling.
Added SKAdNetwork conversion handling, iOS 17.4 support, and application install-time tracking.
Added a debug option to SDK initialization and initialization API requests.
Corrected Swift package module-map placement and package configuration.
Introduced the LinkrunnerKit package identity and dictionary conversion for campaign and attribution models.
Added the option to disable IDFA collection during SDK initialization.
Added attribution retrieval, flexible integration data, additional user properties, and HMAC request signing.
Added Codable and type-safe API models plus optional SHA-256 hashing for user data.
Improved network-monitoring thread safety to prevent concurrent access issues during connection-state updates.
Fixed a network-monitoring initialization race and improved connection-type handling.
Added real-time network monitoring, a Sendable device-data model, and XCFramework build support.
Optimized async device-data collection by caching UIDevice and screen properties.
Initial native iOS SDK release with Swift Package Manager and CocoaPods integration.
